name: Good-student
description: 把错题材料整理成可确认、可解释、可复测的学习行动。
description_zh: 面向家长和学生，完成错题识别、确认、薄弱点分析、学习计划与复测闭环。数据保存在本机，无需登录。
description_en: For parents and students: extract, confirm, analyze, plan, and reassess from wrong-question materials. Local-first, no sign-in.
examples_zh: 帮我整理这批错题，先让我确认识别结果
查看小明最近数学的疑似薄弱点并安排本周计划
记录这次新变式复测结果
导出小明的全部学习数据
examples_en: Extract this batch, but let me confirm each question first
Show Xiaoming's recent math weak points and create a weekly plan
Record the result of this new-variant reassessment
Export all learning data for Xiaoming
